resources.string: Adds a Start recording button to the Tracks list. The trip is saved as a track on this device only and nothing is sent anywhere. Points are kept while the app is open or while you navigate.
Recording continues while the app is open or while you navigate, and pauses by itself when you stop moving.
Track saved. You can show it on the map or export it as GPX.
Nothing to save: the recording was too short.
The track could not be saved. The points are kept and saved the next time you start.
Could not start: an earlier recording is still waiting to be saved.
